observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Various outdoor public locations including a rooftop overlooking a city, a beach pier, an urban alleyway with graffiti, a modern architectural walkway, and a plaza with fountains
observation.dancers: Solo dancers and one couple featuring both men and women across multiple cuts
observation.formation_and_space: Solo or paired dancers performing in open urban spaces, stationary relative to the camera while executing travelling steps in place
observation.posture: Upright torso with slightly bent knees and upright weighted steps
observation.footwork: Rapid shuffling, sliding, hopping, and high-knee stepping synchronised to a fast dance beat; exact weight transfer details cannot be seen due to fast camera cuts and low resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move loosely by the sides, swinging or gesturing, sometimes holding props like a phone or resting on hips
observation.hips_and_torso: Natural hip movement and slight upper body lean following the stepping rhythm
observation.partnering: Mostly solo performance with one brief partner sequence involving synchronized footwork and contact/lifts
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent jumps, hops on one leg, and occasional floor work or leg extensions
observation.costume_and_props: Casual streetwear including crop tops, leggings, shorts, sneakers, caps, and jackets tied around the waist; one dancer holds a smartphone
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement, weight distribution, and subtle heel-toe mechanics are obscured by quick camera cuts, wide angles, and low-resolution frame rates.

signature_moments.what: A dancer in white pants and a crop top performs fast shuffling footwork and high knee kicks inside a fenced area.
A dancer on a concrete path executes rapid sliding step-hops with arms swinging.
A male and female couple on a rooftop drop to their knees and transition into an extended leg lift.
A dancer in shorts performs high-knee stepping and side-to-side shuffling by the water.
